source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of privacy and security threats (PDF 179).

blocks.text: Aaj ki digital duniya mein privacy aur security ke khatre (threats) aam hain aur yeh afraad (individuals) aur idaron (organizations) dono ko mutasir karte hain. Yeh khatre personal maloomat, financial data (paise se mutalliq data) aur poori online hifazat ko compromise (nuqsan ya khatre mein) kar sakte hain. In khatron ko achhi tarah samajhna zaroori hai ta ke mumkina nuqsan se bacha ja sake aur sensitive (hassas, yaani nijji aur qeemti) maloomat mehfooz rahe. Privacy aur security ke khatron ki kuch bari qismein hain, jo agle hisson mein hain.

blocks.prompt: Security threats kin teen cheezon ko khatre mein daal sakte hain?
blocks.explanation: Personal maloomat, financial data (paise se mutalliq data) aur majmooi online security.

items: Privacy aur security threats afraad aur idaron dono ki personal maloomat, financial data aur online security ko khatre mein dalte hain; inhein samajhna hifazat ka pehla qadam hai.
